content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) CONCEPTT study demonstrated that the use of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) during pregnancy can result in significant improvements in hemoglobin A1C levels and gestational outcomes. Importantly, these benefits were achieved without an increase in the incidence of hypoglycemia. The study also found that CGM use was associated with a lower risk of adverse outcomes, including reduced occurrences of macrosomia (high birth weights) and neonatal hypoglycemia.
